meta.name: add-gcal-tool
meta.description: Add Google Calendar as an MCP tool (list calendars, list/search/create events, free/busy queries) using OneCLI-managed OAuth. Multi-calendar and multi-account supported. Mirrors /add-gmail-tool's stub pattern — no raw credentials ever reach the container; OneCLI injects real tokens at request time.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把谷歌日历变成可调用的工具，自动管理日程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在工作流中直接操作谷歌日历
copy.tagline_en: Turn Google Calendar into a callable tool to manage schedules automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to operate Google Calendar directly in your workflow

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能直接调用 Google 日历工具：列出日历、查看或搜索日程、创建事件、查空闲时间等，且支持多个日历和账户。
howto.when: 当用户提出与日历相关的请求时，比如要求列出日历、查看或安排日程、检查空闲时段。

say.text: 看一下我下周一有哪些日程？
帮我创建一个明天下午3点的会议事件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use Google Calendar MCP tools: list calendars, view/search events, create events, and check free/busy, with multi-calendar and multi-account support.
howto.when_en: When the user asks anything calendar-related, e.g. listing calendars, viewing or creating events, or checking availability.

say_en.text: What's on my calendar next Monday?
say_en.note: Claude queries events for that day.

say_en.text: Create a meeting for tomorrow at 3pm.
say_en.note: Claude adds the event via create-event.
